summary: Opened a bounded-liveness question about proposal intake. Sources show node.handleProposals pauses draining and growing the incoming queue while the raft rate limiter or LogDB busy signal is set, and InMemRateLimiter changes its recorded state only after a 10-tick hysteresis window while ignoring follower sizes older than 3 ticks. Partial evidence points to release through entry application shrinking the in-memory log, but the applied-index size accounting, follower-reported sizes and the LogDB busy release path are not yet traced. Investigation recorded unresolved with no defect claim, one behavior entry and a concrete gap; no execution was run.
